decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Loc/Blk, Blk, Design & Access Statement, 001 Received: 15 October 2012 
002 Rev. C, 003 Rev. C, 004 Rev. C, 005 Rev. C Received: 18 December 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows on the side dormer shall be obscurely glazed and non-opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extensions and one front roof light to the house, with alterations to windows on the original dwelling.
